title: Sri Lanka Internet Adoption: October 2025
claim: DataReportal Digital 2026 reports approximately 13.9 million internet users in Sri Lanka in October 2025, corresponding to 59.7% of the population.
decision_use: Use as country-level background only, not a channel-specific reach or audience conversion estimate.
evidence_caveat: Internet adoption is not evidence that a given audience uses any specific marketing channel.

title: Sri Lanka Social Media Identities
claim: DataReportal estimated about 9.00 million social media user identities in Sri Lanka in October 2025. These identities are not necessarily unique individual people.
decision_use: Use for national social context, with explicit duplicate-identity caveat.
evidence_caveat: User identities are not unique users or purchase-ready leads.

title: Facebook Potential Advertising Reach
claim: DataReportal records approximately 9.00 million Facebook advertising-reach accounts for Sri Lanka in late 2025, based on Meta advertising resources.
decision_use: Evidence that Facebook can be considered for local social campaigns; require actual campaign audience validation.
evidence_caveat: Advertising reach ≠ monthly active users, conversion rate, or B2C-only audience.

title: Instagram Potential Advertising Reach
claim: DataReportal cites about 2.25 million Instagram users reachable by advertising tools in Sri Lanka in late 2025.
decision_use: Use as a dated platform-audience context signal when evaluating visual content channels.
evidence_caveat: Not equivalent to guaranteed campaign impressions or performance; denominators differ across channels.

title: YouTube Potential Advertising Reach
claim: DataReportal indicates a potential Sri Lankan YouTube ad audience of about 8.82 million in late 2025.
decision_use: Support considering explanatory-video formats for relevant product audiences.
evidence_caveat: Potential ad reach is not monthly active users or response probability.

title: TikTok Adult Advertising Reach
claim: DataReportal reports a TikTok advertising audience of around 6.79 million users aged 18 and above in Sri Lanka in late 2025.
decision_use: Provide dated national reach context for adult short-video campaigns.
evidence_caveat: Adults only; do not infer reach among younger ages or interpret as campaign conversion evidence.

title: LinkedIn Registered Member Audience
claim: DataReportal lists about 2.90 million LinkedIn members in Sri Lanka in late 2025, and cautions that registered members differ from typical monthly active-user ad metrics.
decision_use: Use as national professional-audience context, not as directly comparable reach to other networks.
evidence_caveat: Registered member counts are not directly comparable to the other platforms’ reach measures.

title: National Urban and Rural Context
claim: DataReportal reports 19.7% urban and 80.3% rural population shares for Sri Lanka in late 2025, using UN population data.
decision_use: Avoid treating Colombo audiences as representative of the whole country; seek segment-level evidence.
evidence_caveat: Population geography alone does not determine channel affinity, literacy, or purchase intent.

title: Sri Lanka Digital Industry and Startup Ecosystem
claim: ICTA identifies development of the digital industry and startup ecosystem as priorities of its digital-industry work, with StartupSL serving as a national startup-related platform.
decision_use: Consider local ecosystem events and startup partnerships as contextual marketing options; do not assume audience scale.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Sri Lankan Digital Services Export Context
claim: The Sri Lanka Export Development Board maintains sector information on ICT and business-process services as part of the country’s service-export landscape.
decision_use: For tech-services targeting external business buyers, consider B2B and export market segmentation.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: EDB Export Services and Market Development
claim: EDB describes export-services support that includes professional services such as ICT and BPM, including market development and international market access.
decision_use: Treat international B2B buyer targeting as a distinct market profile from local Sri Lankan consumer outreach.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Personal Data Protection Framework
claim: Sri Lanka’s Data Protection Authority provides official information on the Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022 and related guidance.
decision_use: Marketing systems handling customer profiles or outreach lists should check current data-protection obligations and avoid unnecessary personally identifiable data.
evidence_caveat: Not legal advice; verify current provisions, commencement, exceptions and consent requirements with authoritative guidance.

title: Google Search Campaign Intent Matching
claim: Google Ads Search campaigns show ads based on relevant searches; advertisers configure keywords, targets, bidding and budgets.
decision_use: Consider Search Ads when prospects express search intent relevant to the offered product.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Google Search Negative Keywords
claim: Google Ads provides negative keywords to help exclude unwanted search queries from ad delivery.
decision_use: Add exclusion testing to an initial high-intent search campaign for qualified leads.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Google Keyword Research Fit
claim: Google Ads Help recommends making keyword lists that reflect how prospective customers search for the offered goods or services.
decision_use: Tie search campaigns to actual customer vocabulary and product problem statements.
source_title: Basic Tips for Building a Keyword List
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: LinkedIn Job and Seniority Targeting
claim: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions supports targeting professional attributes such as job title, company, industry and seniority.
decision_use: LinkedIn may suit B2B segments identified by role, company type and decision-maker seniority.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: LinkedIn Business Campaign Objectives
claim: LinkedIn supports business marketing goals including awareness, lead generation, website visits and conversions, with professional targeting.
decision_use: Choose LinkedIn objectives according to the stated campaign goal rather than a fixed channel ranking.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: LinkedIn Lead Generation Forms
claim: LinkedIn offers native Lead Gen Forms that can be pre-filled from profile details and can report lead-form metrics.
decision_use: When seeking B2B qualified inquiries, consider lead forms and track cost per lead if real campaign data are available.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: TikTok Campaign Goal Categories
claim: TikTok Ads Manager provides campaign objectives covering awareness and website traffic, among other goals.
decision_use: Match short-form video recommendations to campaign objectives and actual content production capacity.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: TikTok Smart Targeting Behavior
claim: TikTok documents smart targeting features that may expand delivery beyond manually defined audience interests in some cases.
decision_use: When planning campaign experiments, inspect the platform’s actual targeting and delivery settings.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: YouTube Video Campaign Targets
claim: Google/YouTube documentation describes video campaigns with objectives such as leads, website traffic and audience engagement alongside targeting and budget decisions.
decision_use: Include YouTube when product demonstrations, walkthroughs or explainer-video assets are available.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: YouTube Audience and Contextual Targeting
claim: YouTube advertising documentation describes location, audience and contextual/topic targeting options for video campaigns.
decision_use: Select video audiences using business-relevant profiles rather than assuming video suits every age segment.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: GA4 Lead Key Event Measurement
claim: Google Analytics supports marking important interactions such as lead submissions as key events, which can be connected to conversion measurements.
decision_use: Define conversion measurement before judging whether a channel produced qualified leads.
source_title: Conversions vs. Key Events in Google Analytics
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Cross-Channel Conversion Measurement
claim: Google Analytics distinguishes key events and advertising conversions in reporting across organic and paid channels.
decision_use: Use consistent outcome definitions when comparing AHP recommendations with observed campaign results.
source_title: Conversions vs. Key Events in Google Analytics
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Meta Ad Set Budget and Audience Controls
claim: Meta Marketing API describes ad sets as entities containing targeting, schedule, and budget controls.
decision_use: Facebook and Instagram campaign feasibility should be judged using actual account-level targeting and budget settings.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Search Engine Optimization Basics
claim: Google Search Central’s SEO guide discusses making content accessible and understandable to search engines and visitors.
decision_use: Recommend website content that directly explains product use cases, customer benefits and terminology.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Technical and Nontechnical Audience Content
claim: The EU DigComp framework structures digital competence across different areas of digital literacy. It is conceptual background, not a validated marketing classification label set.
decision_use: Use Q10/Q11 and separately verified expert labels for marketing-oriented literacy classification, not DigComp citations alone.
evidence_caveat: DigComp is not evidence that a specific customer/persona has Low/Medium/High marketing technical literacy.

title: Small-Budget Search Campaign Needs Evidence
claim: Search ads are configured through keyword, targeting and budget settings; suitability should be evaluated against the advertiser’s real price and campaign constraints.
decision_use: Do not infer that a fixed LKR 15,000 or other cost minimum is officially required from Google documentation.
evidence_caveat: The repository’s per-channel LKR minimums are design assumptions, not verified market CPCs.

title: B2B Channel Fit Requires Persona Evidence
claim: LinkedIn offers occupational and firmographic targeting, but this alone does not prove campaign performance for any particular business.
decision_use: Use explicit B2B persona roles and source-backed targeting capabilities; label ranking weights as assumed until experts review them.
evidence_caveat: Professional targeting capability is not evidence of universal ROI superiority.

title: Content-Led YouTube Recommendation Requirements
claim: Video campaigns use video assets and involve choices about targeting and bidding.
decision_use: Do not highly recommend video channels if the company cannot produce suitable video content without accounting for feasibility.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: TikTok Campaign Planning Needs Creative Capacity
claim: TikTok campaign objectives and account setup depend on the advertiser’s campaign goal, creative assets and actual eligible delivery options.
decision_use: Account for short-video content capability when suggesting TikTok for a new product.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Privacy-Aware Lead Nurturing
claim: Sri Lankan personal-data rules provide relevant compliance context for handling customer/contact lists.
decision_use: Use a compliant opt-in workflow and human review of legal obligations before marketing-email use.
evidence_caveat: Do not assume that this general source resolves every consent or direct-marketing legal requirement.

title: Geographic Interpretation of National Reach
claim: National aggregate internet and platform advertising figures describe the country; they do not directly estimate a single province or local customer segment.
decision_use: For region-specific recommendations, seek validated regional observations and display insufficient data where unavailable.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: LinkedIn Professional Lead Measurement
claim: LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms have metrics for the quantity and cost of leads from targeted professional segments.
decision_use: Recommend collecting actual CPL data before using a channel-performance budget optimizer.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.

title: Avoid Mistaking Ad Reach for Sales
claim: Potential advertising audience measurements represent possible ad reach; they cannot be treated as conversion-rate or ROI measurements.
decision_use: Keep the ranking model separate from commercial performance claims and provide source/date caveats.
evidence_caveat: Do not use this statement as evidence of conversion rate, CPC, ROI, or guaranteed performance.
